name: Olympic Host Cities
description: Which city hosted which Games? Summer and Winter Olympics from Athens 1896 onward.
question: {prompt}

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games, in 1896?
cards.fact: Athens was chosen to honor the ancient Games held at Olympia in Greece.

cards.prompt: Which French resort hosted the first Winter Olympics, in 1924?
cards.fact: It was billed as "International Winter Sports Week" and only later recognized as the first Winter Games.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the Summer Olympics in 1908, 1948 and 2012?
cards.fact: The 1948 "Austerity Games" were held with no new venues built, just after World War II.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the Summer Olympics in 1900, 1924 and 2024?
cards.fact: The 1900 Paris Games were the first to include women athletes.

cards.prompt: Which city became the first to host both a Summer (2008) and a Winter (2022) Olympics?
cards.fact: Beijing reused its 2008 "Water Cube" for curling in 2022, renamed the "Ice Cube."

cards.prompt: Which city’s 2020 Summer Olympics were postponed to 2021 because of the COVID-19 pandemic?
cards.fact: The Games kept the name "Tokyo 2020" even though they were held in 2021.

cards.prompt: Which city was chosen in 2021 to host the 2032 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: It will be Australia’s third Summer Games, after Melbourne 1956 and Sydney 2000.

cards.prompt: Which city will host the 2028 Summer Olympics, its third Games?
cards.fact: Los Angeles also hosted in 1932 and 1984.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1904 Summer Olympics, the first held in the United States?
cards.fact: The Games were folded into the St. Louis World’s Fair and stretched over several months.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1912 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: Stockholm 1912 introduced electronic timing and a public-address system.

cards.prompt: Which Belgian city hosted the 1920 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: The five-ring Olympic flag flew at the Games for the first time in Antwerp.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1928 Summer Olympics, where the Olympic flame was first lit?
cards.fact: The flame burned in a tower beside the stadium throughout the Games.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1936 Summer Olympics, where Jesse Owens won four gold medals?
cards.fact: Berlin 1936 also introduced the torch relay from Olympia.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1952 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: Czech runner Emil Zátopek won the 5,000 m, 10,000 m and marathon there.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1956 Summer Olympics, the first in the Southern Hemisphere?
cards.fact: Australian quarantine rules meant the equestrian events were held in Stockholm.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1960 Summer Olympics, where Abebe Bikila won the marathon barefoot?
cards.fact: Bikila became the first Black African Olympic champion.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1964 Summer Olympics, the first held in Asia?
cards.fact: Japan opened its first bullet train line just in time for the Games.

cards.prompt: At which 1968 Games did Bob Beamon make his record-shattering long jump?
cards.fact: The thin, high-altitude air helped Beamon jump 8.90 meters, a record for 23 years.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1972 Summer Olympics, where Mark Spitz won seven golds?
cards.fact: Spitz’s seven golds stood as the record for a single Games until Michael Phelps won eight in 2008.

cards.prompt: At which 1976 Games did Nadia Comăneci score gymnastics’ first perfect 10?
cards.fact: The scoreboard couldn’t show 10.00, so it displayed 1.00.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1980 Summer Olympics, boycotted by the United States?
cards.fact: The boycott protested the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1984 Summer Olympics, boycotted by the Soviet Union?
cards.fact: LA 1984 turned a profit, rare at the time, largely through corporate sponsorship.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1988 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: Seoul 1988 was the last Summer Games before the fall of the Berlin Wall.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1992 Summer Olympics and the original basketball "Dream Team"?
cards.fact: An archer lit the cauldron by shooting a flaming arrow over it.

cards.prompt: Which US city hosted the centennial Summer Olympics in 1996?
cards.fact: Muhammad Ali lit the cauldron at the opening ceremony.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 2000 Summer Olympics?
cards.fact: Cathy Freeman lit the cauldron, then won the 400 m gold.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 2016 Summer Olympics, the first in South America?
cards.fact: Usain Bolt won both the 100 m and 200 m for the third Games in a row.

cards.prompt: Which New York village hosted the Winter Olympics in both 1932 and 1980?
cards.fact: Lake Placid 1980 saw the US hockey team’s "Miracle on Ice" win over the Soviet Union.

cards.prompt: Which California resort hosted the 1960 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Walt Disney produced the opening and closing ceremonies.

cards.prompt: Which Japanese city hosted the 1972 Winter Olympics, the first Winter Games in Asia?
cards.fact: Sapporo is also famous for its annual Snow Festival of giant ice sculptures.

cards.prompt: Which city hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics, made famous by Jamaica’s bobsled team?
cards.fact: The team inspired the 1993 film "Cool Runnings."

cards.prompt: Which Norwegian town hosted the 1994 Winter Olympics, just two years after Albertville?
cards.fact: From 1994, the Winter and Summer Games alternated every two years.

cards.prompt: Which Japanese city hosted the 1998 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Snowboarding and women’s ice hockey made their Olympic debuts at Nagano.

cards.prompt: Which US city hosted the 2002 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Denver had won the 1976 Winter Games but voters turned them down, so Innsbruck hosted instead.

cards.prompt: Which Canadian city hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Canada won gold in men’s hockey with Sidney Crosby’s overtime "Golden Goal."

cards.prompt: Which Russian Black Sea resort hosted the 2014 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Sochi has a subtropical climate, unusual for a Winter Games host.

cards.prompt: Which South Korean county hosted the 2018 Winter Olympics?
cards.fact: Organizers capitalized the C in "PyeongChang" so it wouldn’t be confused with Pyongyang.
